reviews.shade: numbuzin No.5+ Vitamin Concentrated Serum 30mL Double Set (+No.5 Pack 1ea)
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this Vitamin C Serum for a while now, and it has truly become a staple in my skincare routine. The texture is lightweight and smooth, making it easy to apply and layer with other products. It feels soothing on the skin and, importantly, doesn’t cause any irritation—something I’ve struggled with when using other Vitamin C products.

What sets this serum apart is its impressive formulation. The synergy between Vitamin C and Glutatione works wonders for brightening my complexion. My skin looks noticeably more radiant and even-toned, which is exactly what I was hoping for.

This is my fourth bottle, and I don’t plan on stopping anytime soon. If you're looking for a reliable Vitamin C serum that delivers results without compromising comfort, I highly recommend giving this one a try!
reviews.zh:
我用咗呢款維他命 C 精華一段時間，佢真係已經成為我護膚程序嘅必備品。質地輕盈順滑，好易塗，亦易同其他產品疊加使用。塗喺皮膚上感覺舒緩，而且最重要係冇引起任何刺激——呢點係我用其他維他命 C 產品時一直都頭疼嘅問題。

呢款精華最突出嘅，係佢令人印象深刻嘅配方。維他命 C 同 Glutatione（谷胱甘肽）嘅協同作用，對提亮我嘅膚色效果非常好。我嘅皮膚明顯睇落更亮澤、膚色更均勻，正正係我一直期望嘅效果。

呢個係我第四支，我暫時都唔打算停。如果你想搵一款可靠、又有效果、同時唔影響舒適感嘅維他命 C 精華，我強烈推薦你試吓呢款！

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.5 Glutathione Vitamin Concentrated Serum 30ml Duo Set
reviews.text: This serum has been a lifesaver! I kept seeing many reviews highlighting how it helps with scarring and breakouts. Especially with lightening or fading acne scars. I had a really bad break out due to another product (LaRoche Posay) and my face was really red and irritated. I am already acne prone and the irritation gave me really big welts. I started using this hoping it could help and it DEFINITELY did. I have been using it for about 4 months now and it has been a staple in my routine. The after photo is about a month after using the product. I would definitely recommend!! I have acne prone skin and never had a reaction or negative experience with it on my skin.
reviews.zh: 呢款精華真係救咗我！我一直見到好多評論，都話佢幫助疤痕同爆痘。特別係淡化或者減淡痘疤。我之前因為另一款產品（LaRoche Posay）爆咗好嚴重嘅痘，面部好紅、好刺激。我本身已經易生暗瘡，而刺激令我起咗好大嘅紅腫。我開始用呢款，希望可以幫到我，而結果真係好有效！我用咗大約四個月，而家已經成為我日常嘅必需品。After 相係用咗產品大約一個月之後拍嘅。我一定會推薦！！我係易生暗瘡嘅皮膚，但用呢款從來冇出現過反應或負面經驗。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.5 Glutathione Vitamin Concentrated Serum 30ml Duo Set
reviews.text: This is the first time I´ve done a depigmentation treatment and, in just two months of continuous use (being constant only in the last month), the decrease in the pigmentation of my freckles and the evenness of my skin tone can be seen. It should be noted that I live in the Caribbean, where the sun is quite aggressive and with a UV radiation index that is usually between 9 and 12 points (extreme). Obviously, I've been religious about using sunscreen (including wearing hats, sunglasses, and masks), weekly exfoliating, and occasionally using retinol.
reviews.zh: 呢個係我第一次做淡化色素療程，用咗兩個月，持續使用（但係只係最後一個月先至恆常使用），都見到雀斑色素減淡，膚色都變得更加均勻。要留意，我住喺加勒比海，嗰度太陽好猛，紫外線指數通常介乎 9 至 12 之間（極高）。當然，我一直都好堅持做防曬（包括戴帽、戴太陽眼鏡同口罩）、每星期去角質，同埋間中用視黃醇（Retinol）。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.5 Glutathione Vitamin Concentrated Serum 30ml Duo Set
reviews.text:
HOLY GRAIL PRODUCT! 
Been using this for one week and look at the difference! I made sure to include the receipts with the dates. I've had these post acne marks for quite literally over six weeks. Nothing worked! I saw the BOJ glow and revive serums at TjMaxx and tried giving it a shot (maybe it'd work for this).. completely did nothing for my own skin. Upgraded and watched a ton of reviews and came across this product. Simply look at how moisturized and glowy my skin looks (I know it's so zoomed in lol). I only use this in the morning btw! 

Current MORNING skincare routine:
1. BOJ green plum cleanser
2. Numbuzin no.05+ 
3. Illiyoon moisturizer 
4. Skin1004 sunscreen 

I'm going to update this with new pics after one full month!
reviews.zh:
神級產品！用咗一個禮拜，睇吓分別！我特意附上咗有日期嘅收據。我嘅暗瘡後痘印真係已經超過六個禮拜，點都冇用！我喺 TjMaxx 見到 BOJ glow and revive 精華，就試吓（都係想試吓可唔可以對呢啲有用）……但係對我自己嘅皮膚完全冇用。後來換咗方法，睇咗好多評論，先搵到呢款產品。你睇吓我嘅皮膚幾保濕、幾有光澤（我知道相拍得好近 lol）。我只係早上用呢款！

目前嘅早上護膚程序：
1. BOJ green plum cleanser
2. Numbuzin no.05+
3. Illiyoon moisturizer
4. Skin1004 sunscreen

我會喺一個月之後更新新相！

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.5 Glutathione Vitamin Concentrated Serum 30ml Duo Set
reviews.text: 10/10 recommend this product in combo with the toner from the same line. This product really does work for hyper pigmentation or uneven skin tones. Will say, does lighten your complexion so beware of that. But if you get acne scars where they get dark. This is a holy grail and must have. I have sensitive skin and this did not break me out. Also, I’ve been using this product for well over a month and a half and I just love it. For reference I have medium tan skin tone, sensitive, and combo skin. Before I forget to add, this stuff does not leave an oily feeling in the skin and it does absorb very well. It’s super moisturizing too. So I’d say it’s a win for oily, dry, and combo skin.
reviews.zh: 搭配同系列嘅化妝水一齊用，我會畀十分推薦！呢款產品真係對色素沉澱或者膚色不均勻有效。要講明，佢會令膚色變淺，所以要留意。但係如果你嘅痘印係暗色，呢款就係神級必備品。我係敏感肌，用呢款都冇爆痘。另外，我用咗超過一個半月，真係好鍾意。畀大家參考，我係中等偏啡嘅膚色，敏感肌同混合皮。仲有，呢款唔會令皮膚感覺油膩，吸收得好好。保濕效果都好強。差啲忘咗講，所以我話，對油性、乾性同混合皮都係一個贏家。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.5 Glutathione Vitamin Concentrated Serum 30ml Set (+Pad 6P)
reviews.text:
Enriched with a powerhouse blend of vitamins including Vitamin C, Vitamin E, and Vitamin B5, along with potent antioxidants, it works tirelessly to combat dullness, uneven tone, and signs of aging. Whether you're targeting dark spots, fine lines, or simply seeking a radiant glow, this serum has you covered.

The texture of the serum is lightweight and silky-smooth, gliding effortlessly onto the skin and absorbing quickly without any greasy residue. It feels refreshing and hydrating upon application, instantly quenching the skin's thirst and leaving it feeling soft, supple, and revitalized.

After incorporating this serum into my skincare routine, I've noticed a significant improvement in the overall health and appearance of my skin. My complexion appears more radiant, with a youthful glow that lasts throughout the day. Additionally, I've seen a reduction in the appearance of dark spots and fine lines, thanks to the brightening and anti-aging effects of the vitamins and antioxidants.
reviews.zh:
富含多種維他命，包括維他命 C、維他命 E 同維他命 B5，加上強效抗氧化成分，能夠持續對抗暗啞、膚色不均同衰老跡象。不論你係想針對色斑、幼紋，定係只係想要透亮光澤，呢款精華都照顧到晒。

呢款精華質地輕盈幼滑，容易推開，吸收好快，冇油膩殘留。塗上之後有清爽同保濕嘅感覺，即刻補充皮膚嘅水分，令皮膚感覺柔軟、有彈性，充滿活力。

喺我將呢款精華加入護膚程序之後，我發覺皮膚嘅整體健康同外觀都有明顯改善。膚色睇落更加透亮，有種青春光澤，全日都保持住。另外，我見到色斑同幼紋都淡咗，多得維他命同抗氧化成分嘅提亮同抗衰老效果。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.5 Glutathione Vitamin Concentrated Serum 30ml Duo Set
reviews.text:
I have stubborn hyperpigmentation left over from acne on my skin. Out of all the products in my routine and rotation, I think this product worked the best to help fade them. I have dry sensitive skin and didn't feel like this irritated it at all.

Other products I tried before (and in conjunction with) the numbuzin no. 5+ serum:

- SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin Anti Blemish Serum
- Cos De BAHA Arbutin Niacinamide Serum*
- numbuzin No. 3 Super Glowing Essence Toner**
- numbuzin No. 3 Skin Softening Serum*

** - still using every day
* - use once in a while, rotate with the No. 5+ serum

I used the products listed above for almost a year and I didn't see a big difference in my scars/hyperpigmentation until I added the No. 5+ serum in December 2023 -January 2024.

First picture was taken October 2023. Second picture I took today.
reviews.zh:
我皮膚上有頑固嘅暗瘡後色素沉澱。喺我所有護膚產品同輪替使用嘅產品之中，我覺得呢款最能夠幫助淡化佢哋。我係乾性敏感肌，而且完全冇覺得佢刺激到皮膚。

以下係我之前用過嘅產品（同 numbuzin no. 5+ 精華同時使用或者先後使用）：

- SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin Anti Blemish Serum
- Cos De BAHA Arbutin Niacinamide Serum*
- numbuzin No. 3 Super Glowing Essence Toner**
- numbuzin No. 3 Skin Softening Serum*

** - 而家每日都仍在用
* - 間中用，同 No. 5+ 精華輪流使用

我用咗以上產品差唔多一年，但係直至 2023 年 12 月至 2024 年 1 月加入咗 No. 5+ 精華，我先至見到疤痕／色素沉澱有好大改善。

第一張相係 2023 年 10 月拍嘅，第二張相係我今日拍嘅。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.5 Glutathione Vitamin Concentrated Serum 30ml Set (+Pad 6P)
reviews.text: i have heard amazing things about this product, so i was so excited to use it. i did not know it contains tranexamic acid, which is a blood clotting ingredient often used in medicine to treat heavy menstrual cycles. i know that the quantity is significantly smaller in this product than it would be when used as medicine, but i don’t feel comfortable using the product anyway. i wish i knew this before purchasing, i’m super disappointed since i’ve heard such great things.
reviews.zh: 我聽過好多好評，所以好期待用呢款產品。我之前唔知道佢含有氨甲環酸（tranexamic acid），呢個係一種促進血液凝固嘅成分，常見用於醫療上治療經量過多。我知道呢款產品入面嘅份量比用作藥物時細好多，但係我用呢款產品都係唔舒服。我真係希望買之前已經知道，我好失望，因為我聽過咁多好評。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
